free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixed seed for reproducible tensor initialisation

free_parameters.name: batch_size
free_parameters.why: smallest batch; the assertion reads only attn_sparsity

free_parameters.name: target_seq_len
free_parameters.why: decoding step has one target token; assertion does not depend on it

free_parameters.name: n_head
free_parameters.why: single attention head; assertion does not depend on head count

free_parameters.name: head_dim
free_parameters.why: smallest usable head width for the real layer_norm/linear code

free_parameters.name: mask_len
free_parameters.why: attention-mask width only feeds src_s after the target decision

free_parameters.name: cache_shape
free_parameters.why: tiny mixed-cache stand-in object; only its shape[0] is read before the assert

free_parameters.name: donate
free_parameters.why: do not delete the input tensors during the test

free_parameters.name: compress_cache
free_parameters.why: uncompressed path avoids compression devices before the target
